test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 1.**
solution: The correct answer is: **Increasing** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The verb "**increasing**" means to become larger in size, amount, or number. (आकार, मात्रा या संख्या में बड़ा होना) • It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank because it fits the context of growth or progress. • **Example**: *The company is increasing its profits every year.* Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Strengthening **means to make something stronger or more resilient. (किसी चीज़ को अधिक मजबूत या अधिक लचीला बनाना) • **Shining **means to give off light or radiance. (प्रकाश या चमक देना) • **Developing **means to grow or evolve over time. (समय के साथ बढ़ना या विकसित होना) 14c:Ta25, The correct answer is: **Caters**
